meaning: 200 m cells inside the final perimeter. kind=observed-support: earliest VIIRS detection within 400 m. kind=interpolated: median of the 6 nearest supported cells. Arrival times are bounded by overpass times; this is not a mapped front.

limitations: Retrospective reconstruction clipped to the later final perimeter.
The first associated thermal detection does not establish the exact time of fire arrival.
Cells supported by detections are also reconstructed; they are not observed perimeters.
